name: campaign_schedule
description: Select the next dependency-ready, file-disjoint feature-campaign wave and build its dynamic sub-workflow inputs.

plan.description: Validated planner DAG: an object with a 'tasks' array, or the tasks array itself. An invalid/missing plan short-circuits to a stalled, empty wave.

maxTasks.description: Maximum number of tasks the plan may contain before validation fails.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repo checkout, forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

completedTaskIds.description: Task IDs already completed. Accepts a comma-separated string or an array of strings.

blockedTaskIds.description: Task IDs to exclude from this wave even if otherwise ready. Accepts a comma-separated string or an array of strings.

maxParallelism.description: Maximum number of file-disjoint tasks to pick for this wave.

wave.description: Current wave number, used to build dynamic task reference names and forwarded to each subtask input.

agent.description: Coding agent identifier forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

model.description: Model identifier forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

maxTurns.description: Max agent turns forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

maxBudgetUsd.description: USD budget ceiling forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

sessions.description: Map of task ID to resumable session ID, used to populate resumeSessionId for each dynamic subtask.

specContextPath.description: Spec context path forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

contextPaths.description: Extra context paths forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

codePromptTemplate.description: Code prompt template forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

codePromptTemplateSource.description: Code prompt template source forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

feedback.description: Checkpoint feedback forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

modelProfile.description: Model profile name forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

modelPolicy.description: Model policy object forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

modelPolicySource.description: Model policy source forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

modelPolicySha256.description: Model policy checksum forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

modelsConfig.description: Models config path forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

modelOverrides.description: Per-task model overrides forwarded to each dynamic campaign_subtask input.

valid.description: True when the input plan validated; false short-circuits with an empty, stalled wave.

errors.description: Plan validation failures. Empty when valid.

normalizations.description: Plan normalization notes. Only present when the plan was invalid.

tasks.description: Normalized plan tasks. Only present when the plan was invalid.

order.description: Topologically sorted task IDs. Only present when the plan was invalid.

ready.description: Full task objects selected for this wave (dependency-ready, not blocked, file-disjoint).

readyIds.description: IDs of tasks selected for this wave.

blockedIds.description: Sorted IDs explicitly excluded from this wave.

unresolvedIds.description: IDs of remaining tasks not selected for this wave (blocked or dependencies unmet).

done.description: True when no tasks remain. Only present when the plan was valid.

stalled.description: True when tasks remain but none could be selected (e.g. unmet dependencies, all blocked, or the plan was invalid).

dynamicTasks.description: FORK_JOIN_DYNAMIC task descriptors, one SUB_WORKFLOW campaign_subtask per selected task.

dynamicTasksInput.description: Map of dynamic task reference name to its campaign_subtask sub-workflow input.
